verdict.rationale: Groq's llms.txt lists a first-party integration page (docs/jigsawstack), which points to vendor-hosted guides for third-party tools. The OpenAI-compatible base_url swap only gives a generic route into agent tooling. No guide for a named coding agent or mainstream agent framework is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit first-party guides for coding agents (e.g., IDE/CLI agents), documented guides for major agent frameworks, setup depth beyond a single listing, and independent corroboration of working integrations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the provider into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, first-party integration guides

citations.quote: We designed Groq API to be mostly compatible with OpenAI's client libraries, making it easy to configure your existing applications to run on Groq
